name: Modu Chanyu
role: Chanyu of the Xiongnu Empire from 209 to 174 BCE
contribution: The son of Touman and the founder of the empire of the Xiongnu.
legacy: He secured the throne and established a powerful Xiongnu Empire by successfully unifying the tribes of the Mongolian–Manchurian grassland in response to the loss of Xiongnu pasture lands to invading Qin forces commanded by Meng Tian in 215 BCE.

checks.lead: Modu (c. 234–174 BCE) was the son of Touman and the founder of the empire of the Xiongnu. He came to power by ordering his men to kill his father in 209 BCE.
